about: Tracks the site is allowed to host: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, so the credit in each song's attribution must be shown. Each plays from /music/<id>.m4a (R2 bucket airdeck-music; local copies in public-music/, gitignored; upload with `npm run upload-music`). bpm starts as incompetech's published tempo and is replaced by the measured tempo; beat is measured by `node scripts/analyze-library.mjs --public`. Only add audio the owner has the right to publish (CC BY, CC0, own, or permission).
